long_biography.plain_text:
Carrillo Díaz worked in Mexico’s capital markets as an actuary and senior figure at Casa de Bolsa Finamex. He held an honorary chairmanship and later served on an executive committee with responsibilities delegated by the board. The brokerage combines securities dealing with investment products and funds, giving his career a broader financial-services setting.

His economic interest continued after his operating roles changed. He has retained a significant beneficial holding within a family shareholder group. Separate trusts appear in the group’s arrangements for members of the next generation. His son Eduardo Arturo Carrillo Madero serves as Finamex chairman and chief executive.
